title: Any pro trader here?
author: TheChechenKnight
selftext:
Hello 

Im looking forward to make an Expert Advisor but no strategy to make the EA follow, i need someone to give me a strategy and i make the EA and we both use it for free lifetime + if it goes as expected or beyond expectations we can brand it and sell. 👌🏼

So yea i just want someone to share with me a strategy and i share with him the EA. (If that is possible)

comments.author: Silent_Finger8450
comments.body: This is reddit, not the miracle factory.

replies.author: TheChechenKnight
replies.body: Oh!!! Thank you for reminding me i thought im in Miracle Factory 😅

replies.author: TheChechenKnight
replies.body: Im asking for someone who has a strategy not useless person. 😘

replies.author: IGOSODAMNHAM
replies.body: You think someone is going to randomly just give you their edge? You’re an idiot.

replies.author: TheChechenKnight
replies.body: U think everyone is like you? Your selfish.

replies.author: IGOSODAMNHAM
replies.body: A real edge takes years of work, it’s not something you give away so it stops working. Anyone who gives you anything is not going to work. You want a shortcut because you’re lazy and you’re not going to get one.

replies.author: TheChechenKnight
replies.body: You never know if im going to get one or not, life can surprise you in many ways 😉😁
